args.description: air dodge: curls up tightly in mid-air in the same place, a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged held still against his body, the body staying in the middle of the picture, then opens up again in the same pose. The character stays at the same place in the frame (the game moves him), always facing right, seen from the side; keep his look, proportions and colours exactly. Only the character is drawn, with what he holds: no effect, no motion streak, no speed lines, no trail behind the limbs or the weapon, no glow, no energy, no projectile, no smoke, no dust, no ground, the whole body inside the picture. Every frame shows the arms, legs and weapon clearly in a crisp pose, never blurred.
args.subject_description: a young man with spiky black hair streaked with red, red eyes, a long red scarf, an open black and red coat over a bare chest, black trousers, red and black boots, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
args.initial_pose: in mid-air facing right, knees tucked, holding a huge spiked black and red greatsword, larger and more jagged
